blurb: A case supplies an identity only when the actor has one to give. An actor that declares no `identity`, and the failure principals `Nobody`, `Forged`, `Stale` and `Expired`, which present a missing or bad credential and so no verified caller, take no argument. Write `by Nobody`, not `by Nobody("bob")`. For an actor that does declare an identity and is given none, see `bynk.test.actor_identity_required`.
summary: A call-site `by <Actor>(x)` supplies an identity to an actor that takes none — a unit-identity actor (e.g. `Visitor`) or `Nobody`.
